text_block_list.text:
When I went up to the rooftop to get some fresh air,
Gold Ship and Grass Wonder
were standing there together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... As the Uma King, something is still missing!
To find it, I gotta embark on a journey...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A journey sounds lovely.
However, you cannot go today~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You promised to race against everyone
on the training track today, remember~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it.
You wanna say "time is limited," right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, though! Don't cry just 'cause you'll miss me...!
We'll meet again someday!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Goodness, Golshi-senpai.
We need to bring her back right away~.
choice_data_list: I'll help you look for her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, thank you, <chrname> <trainer>.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us meet back here once you find her.
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san went on a journey?!
¡No! What about our match today?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Search! Locate! Appreheeeend!!
I will definitely capture her!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san went on a journey, you say?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Does she think she can simply flee from a contest against King?!
I shall track her down without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haven't seen her~. Come to think of it,
didn't we promise to run together today?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Allriiiight, roger that.
I'll take a look around on my way back to the academy~.

Even after all that searching, Gold Ship was nowhere to be found.
When I returned to the rooftop—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... The day draws near when this entire world
shall belong to Uma King Golshi...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Finally found yooou!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good grief!
Do you have any idea how long we've been searching for you?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so you were here all along~.
No wonder we couldn't find you anywhere else~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you for your hard work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So you caught me... Heh,
they say the culprit always returns to the scene of the crime.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was watching all of you from up on high.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, I realized what Uma King Golshi
was missing... what I truly needed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Four horse girls gathered together in search of me...
Having heard that much, you get it now, don'tcha?

Gold Ship wore an intensely serious expression
as she waited for an answer.

The Uma King and four horse girls.
The only thing that comes to mind is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sharp! I'd make you one of 'em too... but well,
the Four Heavenly Kings gotta be four people by definition~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then you play the Hero, the Hero!
If you beat me, I'll give ya half the world!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get right into the battle!!
Ora! Come at me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Before that, you must face us!!
Appreheeeend!!

El Condor Pasa and King Halo grabbed Gold Ship
by both arms and dragged her away
across the floor...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha~. Rather than an "Uma King,"
she looks more like an "alien" getting hauled off~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's build the Heavenly Kings' castle in outer space!
Gotta pack it full of booby traps!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to foster unity among the Four Heavenly Kings,
let us all go run together first~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
I only ask that you refrain from causing trouble.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El wants a wrestling ring built inside her castle!
With a match gong for the doorbell!!

The Uma King's antics were utterly chaotic,
but she seemed to share a great bond with her Four Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Subordinates of Uma King Golshi,
the Ultimate Four Heavenly Kings!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Habanero" El! "Angler" Sky!
"The Monster" Grass! And 1 other person!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why am I the only one relegated to "1 other person"?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If El gets a title, she wants a much cooler
ring name than that!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm fine with mine~.
Sounds like I can just kick back and fish all day, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... It seems I am the only one
with a name fit for battle~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that we got the Uma King and Four Heavenly Kings,
we gotta prepare a Hero next.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and we also need someone to tearfully betray the Hero's party,
plus a villainous prime minister trying to usurp the kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, the Uma King never gets a break!

—And so, having gathered her Four Heavenly Kings,
the journey of the great Uma King continued.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You idiot, if there's 4 or more people, it's gotta be hot pot! Hot pot!
Let's do a mystery hot pot and summon the Shirataki Demon!
choice_data_list: What are you even talking about...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It is foolish to seek reason or logic
in anything this person does...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm in such a hot pot mood today, man.
Got an earthenware pot? An earthenware pot! Guess I'll make one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You guys go hunting and gather ingredients!
Both edible stuff and totally inedible stuff!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go dig up some clay
to sculpt the earthenware pot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll go catch some fish, then...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. It is far too early for dinner~.
First, let us get ready to run~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That is right! The hot pot sounds interesting, but
we were really looking forward to our match!!

Gold Ship was dragged away
across the floor by her friends...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hot pooot~! Hey, you over there!
Get everything prepped for us~! Enough for everyone!
Wild and carefree, going wherever the wind blows.

That, undoubtedly,
was the true charm of Gold Ship.
